comment: DEL-83: the parts of a release in their fixed order. `needs` are other parts whose same stage must have passed first; a part with no need on another never waits for it. Each stage lists kit steps (tools/rv-release/steps/<name>.sh, run through steps/run) and built-in checks (lib/predeploy.mts).
